title: Hunt — Ricochet
tagline: A maze, a few rivals and nowhere to hide.
teaser: The 1980s maze free-for-all, as a neon arena lit by line of sight. Bank shots off mirrors, roll slime down the corridors and climb a ten-match career against the bots. Lift the fog, slow the bots or play turn by turn: the rules come straight from the original game server.

manPage.synopsis: hunt — move through the maze, find rivals, be the last one standing.
manPage.description: Conrad Huang, Ken Arnold and Greg Couch built hunt at the UCSF Computer Graphics Lab as a game played across many terminals in one shared maze.

howToPlay: Tag the match's number of rivals before you are hit out three times.
Easy: arrows walk and turn you, Space fires. Aim: arrows walk, Shift + arrow fires that way.
Too hard? In Settings, lift the Fog, slow the bots or play Turn by turn.
